description: Hosted MCP server for US tax classification of on-chain transactions across 80+ chains, returning canonical event categories, US tax treatment, confidence, and review flags.

commands: Add https://mcp.cryptotaxedge.com/ as a remote Streamable HTTP MCP connector with Authorization: Bearer <CTE_API_KEY>
